text:
Kuch baatein honthon tak aakar hi ruk gayi,
Tumne pucha nahi, maine kuch kaha nahi।
Faasle dono taraf se poore the magar,
Safar yeh be-awaz sa hi chal pada.
Jaane anjaane hi sahi, tera naam le liya,
Jab bhi dil se koi dua ka silsila chala।
title: Adhuri Si Khamoshi
description: A soft and heartfelt reflection on unspoken love and silent feelings that remain within the heart.
